prompt:
Our clinical informatics team needs to prepare a patient discharge letter for ingestion into our NLP pipeline, but it must be fully de-identified first before any AI system touches it. The original letter is at:

  /workspace/clinical_docs/discharge_letters/discharge_letter_fielding.txt

Please process this document so that all patient-identifying information is replaced with appropriate labelled placeholders, while keeping all clinical content intact (medications, diagnoses, procedures, test results, clinical observations, appointment dates, and clinician names must all remain readable). Alongside the cleaned document, we need a formal audit trail showing exactly what was replaced.

Save the result as a single file named `discharge_letter_fielding_redacted.txt` inside the `/workspace/nlp_pipeline/input_staging/` directory.
